english: For a real number $t$, let $\{t\}=t-[t]$, where $[t]$ denotes the greatest integer less than or equal to $t$. Then the value of $\displaystyle\lim_{n\to\infty}n\left(1-\left\{\sqrt{n^{2}+40n}\right\}\right)$, where $n$ takes natural number values, is ______.
hindi: वास्तविक संख्या $t$ के लिए माना कि $\{t\}=t-[t]$ है, जहाँ $[t]$, $t$ से कम या उसके बराबर महत्तम पूर्णांक को दर्शाता है। तब $\displaystyle\lim_{n\to\infty}n\left(1-\left\{\sqrt{n^{2}+40n}\right\}\right)$ का मान, जहाँ $n$ प्राकृत संख्या मान लेता है, ______ है।
solution: (The fractional part tends to $1$, not to $\{20\}=0$, because the root approaches $n+20$ from below.)
solution_full: Note the trap: $\sqrt{n^{2}+40n}\approx n+20$ suggests a fractional part near $0$, but the root is always just below $n+20$, so the fractional part tends to $1$.
originality_note: New: the square root approaches the integer n + 20 from below, so its fractional part tends to 1 rather than 0, and the rate of approach (400/(2n)) is what is asked (way 4). Closest known: lim {sqrt(n^2 + n)} = 1/2. Different because: with an even coefficient the limit of the fractional part sits at the jump of the fractional-part function, and the second-order term becomes the answer.
blueprint_concepts: Evaluation of limit involving GIF and fractional part

concept_use.Evaluation of limit involving GIF and fr: [sqrt(n^2+40n)] = n + 19 for n >= 181 is needed to rewrite 1 - {.} as n + 20 - sqrt(n^2+40n).

stem_review: Read as a student: every function has a stated domain, every symbol is introduced before use, every condition is given, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed with sympy/mpmath and is unique and equal to the Answer Plan; no hyperbolic functions or asymptotes. Checked that {t} and [t] are defined, that n ranges over natural numbers (stated), that the floor value holds for n >= 181 so the limit is unaffected, and 200 is a positive 3-digit integer (mpmath at n = 10^9 gives 199.999996). Changed: No change.
key_step: Showing the floor is n + 19 (the root is just below n + 20) and rationalising.
justification: One GIF observation plus a standard rationalisation, numerical format; the 'tends to 1, not 0' trap adds a step. L2, comparable to 2025-P2-Q1 (L2).
